hosted_environmental_measurement.rule: No server-side energy or carbon estimate is produced for hosted providers because infrastructure, utilization, power, and electricity mix are not exposed by the recorded API telemetry.

interpretive_principle: Environmental precision should not exceed infrastructure knowledge.

local_environmental_measurement.aggregation: Session-level CPU, GPU, RAM, total energy, and emissions estimates are summed across all production sessions contributing to the 12,000 finalized decisions for each local model.
local_environmental_measurement.load_timing: First valid request per session is reported as session-start load. It is not labelled a perfect cold start because OS/filesystem/driver caches may persist between sessions.
local_environmental_measurement.normalized_metrics: Per-1,000-decision energy/emissions values are run-average normalizations of measured session totals, not direct per-request carbon measurements.

request_level_metrics.latency: End-to-end including retries and backoff. Summaries are retained for all scheduled decisions and separately for valid and invalid outputs so operational failures do not masquerade as ordinary successful-request latency.
request_level_metrics.monetary_cost: recorded only when dated provider pricing and usage accounting were available
request_level_metrics.retries: explicit adapter retries; SDK retries disabled where applicable
